# Learning Booklet Studio 0.1.3

This is the first production OSS release of Learning Booklet Studio: one Codex plugin, one public `$build-learning-booklet` skill, a deterministic I0/P0–P10 workflow engine, and an optional local MCP Apps workspace for inspecting progress, decisions, evidence, and repair state.

Highlights:

- manifest-only, plan-only, and plan-then-build terminal modes;
- exactly three task-specific design-system choices when visual direction is unresolved;
- immutable parent/child decision-resume semantics with crash-safe reconciliation;
- a self-contained, accessible workflow widget with safe render recovery;
- deterministic one-file HTML booklet generation and fail-closed verification;
- exact-candidate native desktop proof on Intel macOS, with Apple Silicon status retained as a non-blocking compatibility advisory;
- SHA-256 manifests, checksums, and GitHub build-provenance attestation.

See `CHANGELOG.md` for the full 0.1.0–0.1.3 history, compatibility baseline, and migration notes.
